title: Problem Framing
summary: Define the decision ML will support before choosing a model.
solves: Misalignment between model output and product value.
useWhen: At the start of every ML system discussion.
tradeoff: A tractable proxy target may not perfectly represent the product goal.
commonMistake: Starting with a model family instead of a decision and baseline.

title: Label Design
summary: Specify how ground truth is created, delayed, and corrected.
solves: Ambiguous supervision and noisy learning targets.
useWhen: Training depends on user behavior, review outcomes, or future events.
tradeoff: High-quality labels are often slower and more expensive.
commonMistake: Treating an observable click as unbiased preference.

title: Data Leakage
summary: Prevent training features from containing unavailable future information.
solves: Offline results that collapse in production.
useWhen: Joining time-dependent labels, aggregates, or post-outcome data.
tradeoff: Strict point-in-time data is harder to build and query.
commonMistake: Randomly splitting records whose features share future context.

title: Feature Serving
summary: Deliver consistent features to training and inference paths.
useWhen: Several models reuse features or online freshness matters.
tradeoff: Central infrastructure adds operational and governance cost.
commonMistake: Assuming a feature store automatically guarantees point-in-time correctness.

title: Offline Evaluation
summary: Compare candidates on held-out data with segment-aware metrics.
solves: Fast, repeatable model screening before online exposure.
useWhen: Developing, selecting, or validating a model change.
tradeoff: Offline metrics remain proxies for real user and business impact.
commonMistake: Reporting only one aggregate metric and hiding weak segments.

title: Online Experimentation
summary: Measure causal product impact under controlled exposure.
solves: Uncertainty about whether a model improves user outcomes.
useWhen: The change is safe to test and the outcome can be measured.
tradeoff: Experiments take traffic, time, and careful interference analysis.
commonMistake: Optimizing the primary metric while ignoring guardrails.

title: Model Serving
summary: Run model inference within latency, freshness, and reliability budgets.
solves: Turning trained artifacts into dependable product decisions.
useWhen: Predictions are needed online, nearline, or in batch.
tradeoff: Freshness and model complexity compete with cost and latency.
commonMistake: Discussing the model without fallback, rollout, or feature failure behavior.

title: Drift Monitoring
summary: Detect changes in inputs, predictions, and eventual outcomes.
solves: Silent degradation as users and environments change.
useWhen: Production data may diverge from the training distribution.
tradeoff: Statistical drift does not always imply business harm.
commonMistake: Triggering retraining from drift alone without quality evidence.

title: Retrieval and Ranking
summary: Narrow a large corpus before applying expensive scoring.
solves: Low-latency selection from millions of candidates.
useWhen: Recommendation, search, advertising, and feed systems need multi-stage decisions.
tradeoff: Early retrieval errors cannot be fixed by a later ranker.
commonMistake: Evaluating only the final ranker while ignoring candidate recall.

title: RAG Evaluation
summary: Measure retrieval, answer grounding, and usefulness separately.
solves: Diagnosing whether a knowledge assistant fails before or during generation.
useWhen: A generator uses retrieved documents as evidence.
tradeoff: Evaluation needs representative questions and often human judgment.
commonMistake: Treating fluent answers as proof of grounded correctness.
